output.hook: What if your wireframes could become real, responsive layouts — not just mockups?

scenes.visual: Hand-drawn wireframe on screen transforming into a live grid layout
scenes.voiceover: What if your wireframes could become real, responsive layouts — not just mockups?

scenes.visual: GridFrame interface: rough frames being sketched, auto-resolved into responsive grid
scenes.voiceover: GridFrame is a layout-first design tool. You sketch frames. It builds a real grid system — with breakpoints, flow, and clean structure.

scenes.voiceover: It even audits your design for overflow and breakpoint bugs before handoff. Caught 140 real bugs in alpha users’ sites.

scenes.visual: Code export window showing clean, linted CSS
scenes.voiceover: The CSS passes stylelint with zero warnings. We tested it in real repos.
No more layout lies. Just layouts that ship. Join 3,400 others on the waitlist.
